title: How Spring MVC handles a request
context: How does Spring MVC process an HTTP request?

source.title: JavaGuide (Snailclimb): Spring knowledge and questions
source.note: Translated and condensed into English; see content/sources/javaguide/NOTICE.md.

answer: The DispatcherServlet receives the request. A HandlerMapping finds the controller method for the URL. A HandlerAdapter invokes it, after argument resolvers have bound the parameters and converters have read the body. The controller returns a view name, a model, or a body annotated with @ResponseBody, which is serialised by a message converter. For views, a ViewResolver picks the template. Interceptors and filters run around this chain.

points.title: DispatcherServlet
points.why: It is the front controller that routes every request through the chain.

points.title: Body conversion
points.why: @ResponseBody and @RequestBody use HttpMessageConverters to read and write JSON.
